relationships.subject: aryl sulfonamide Nav1.7 inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: This research presents conformational-independent and 3D field-based QSAR modeling for a series of aryl sulfonamide acting as Nav1.7 inhibitors.

key_findings: QSAR (conformation-independent and 3D) models of aryl sulfonamide Nav1.7 inhibitors were built and used to design new candidate analgesics, supported by docking.
